title: Agentic OS MCP server package.json (structural)
description: An MCP server is a TypeScript package, not a frontmatter file — so this primitive is a CONVENTION LINTER, not a schema validator (see spec.md). The one structured, machine-checkable artifact in a server dir is its package.json; this schema checks that backbone. The real value of the linter (shared-factory dependency, src/index.ts -> tools/*.ts layout, system_health presence, snake_case tool names) lives in validate.mjs as code, because none of it is expressible as JSON Schema over a single file.
